_comment: A faithful SUBSET of governance/identities.template.json — the six identities the four streams name, copied verbatim so this fixture cannot teach a shape the real registry does not have. It exists so the observer-independence rules actually bite here: checkObserver() is lenient when no registry is present (`if (registry && !entry)`), so an example with no identities.json would exercise the signature path and skip AD-R19/AD-R20 entirely, which is the kind of half-check this directory exists to close.

groups.builders: first-line identities that author changes (humans and agents)
groups.second-line: independent risk / compliance / validation identities — MUST be disjoint from builders

identities.display: Floor projector — git read → collaboration-surface write
Floor freezer — exports a collaborative draft into a branch and opens the PR; never merges
Floor bridge — TRANSCRIBES an external decision into an approval attestation. Proves custody, never authority
